errors.description: The drawing is a symmetric front elevation with both collar leaves equally presented. The render is an oblique ~40-degree three-quarter view of a shirt laid at an angle. The wearer's-left leaf is compressed into a wedge roughly a quarter the linear size of the image-right leaf, so the two leaves cannot be compared to each other or to the drawing.
errors.expected: Front elevation, camera on the garment's centre line, both collar leaves subtending equal area
errors.actual: Oblique three-quarter staging; image-left leaf severely foreshortened
errors.correction: Shoot the collar square-on from directly in front at collar height, centre line of the placket vertical and centred in frame, so both collar leaves render at equal scale and the pair reads as a matched set.

errors.description: The single annotated dimension on this blueprint is a 60.00-degree spread, printed with leader lines to both tips, and independently reconstructed from those leader lines as 60.1 degrees (left arm 32.0 off vertical, right 28.1). In the render the oblique view collapses the left arm so no spread angle can be read at all. This is the defining and only annotated attribute of the option.
errors.expected: A measurable 60-degree included angle between the leaves, the narrowest spread of the five siblings
errors.actual: Spread angle not measurable; the left leaf is edge-on
errors.correction: Present the collar closed at the throat with both leaves lying flat and symmetric so the included angle between them reads as a narrow 60 degrees, visibly tighter than a standard collar.

errors.description: This render is interchangeable with the candidates for collar-sq-65 and collar-regular-20: same oblique staging, lighting, crop, shirt and background. The files are byte-distinct but a customer choosing between these three menu entries would see three copies of one photograph.
errors.expected: A photograph immediately distinguishable from the other four options on the same Collar Style menu, driven by its unique 60-degree narrow spread
errors.actual: Generic angled shirt photo indistinguishable from two sibling options
errors.correction: Frame the collar so its narrow 60-degree spread and short acute points are the dominant read, with the collar filling the frame and both leaves visible.

errors.description: The blueprint shows the two collar leaves crossing at the throat over a fastened band button (a small circle at the crossing). The render shows the collar open, leaves separated, neckband gaping, with no fastened throat button visible.
errors.expected: Collar leaves meeting and crossing at a closed throat button, band fastened as drawn
errors.actual: Collar hanging open and unfastened; band gapes at the rear
errors.correction: Fasten the top band button so the two collar leaves converge and cross at the throat exactly as drawn, with the band closed all the way round the neck.

errors.description: The 5.8 cm point length cannot be verified. In the blueprint the tips sit 13.5px below the leaf-crossing line against a collar band of comparable scale; in the render the oblique projection removes any usable relationship between point length and band height, and no scale reference is present.
errors.expected: A short 5.8 cm point, readable as roughly a third of the visible collar band depth
errors.actual: Point length not measurable from this viewpoint
errors.correction: Include the full collar band height in frame alongside the point so point length reads proportionally against the band as a short contemporary 5.8 cm leaf.

No traced annotation: zero bluish and zero reddish saturated pixels across a 256,960-pixel sample
White crisp cotton poplin with clean edge topstitching along the leaf edge
forbiddenChanges: do not alter any checklist item this attempt already passed

do not change the garment part, orientation, or any other option's geometry

notes: Blueprint is 229x244, so roughly 1px equals 3-4mm of real collar; fine tip geometry is at the edge of what is resolvable and that was stated rather than inventing figures. Measurable on the drawing: printed 60.00 degrees, independently reconstructed as 60.1; both tips converge to a single pixel, genuinely acute; tip separation 36.5px, the narrowest of the five drawings. NOT measurable on the render: spread angle, point length, leaf symmetry - all defeated by the oblique viewpoint. The option's one annotated attribute is entirely unreadable and the photo duplicates two siblings.
